hypotheses.F0_suffix_fisher_contraction_is_numerica: JVP/VJP duality has relative error at most 1e-4 for every site.
hypotheses.F1_suffix_conditioned_taylor_preserves_b: Effect-weighted KL recovery is at least 0.60 and median per-example recovery at least 0.60 in every cell.
hypotheses.F2_suffix_conditioning_beats_local_scori: Taylor suffix-Fisher improves effect-weighted KL recovery over Taylor local scoring by at least 0.15 in every cell.
hypotheses.F3_suffix_conditioning_closes_half_the_e: Suffix conditioning closes at least half the gap from Taylor-local to endpoint-local recovery in every cell.
hypotheses.F4_endpoint_direction_plus_suffix_metric: Endpoint-informed suffix-Fisher selection recovers at least 0.80 effect-weighted KL in every cell.
hypotheses.F5_explicit_midpoint_identifies_truncati: Explicit-midpoint suffix-Fisher exceeds Taylor suffix-Fisher by at least 0.10 in cells where frozen Taylor-to-midpoint cosine was below 0.80.
hypotheses.F6_suffix_conditioned_selector_transfers: Taylor suffix-Fisher recovery differs by at most 0.15 between FineWeb and TinyStories at each layer.
hypotheses.F7_high_effect_behavior_is_preserved: Taylor suffix-Fisher recovers at least 0.55 KL in the highest-effect quartile in every cell.
hypotheses.F8_selector_is_prospective: Prospective Taylor and explicit-midpoint suffix-Fisher scores use only weights, the declared edit, and midpoint state before finite endpoint deltas or logits are inspected.
